recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-11347; do not publish a separate duplicate decision for FHIR-12247, and treat FHIR-11176 as related context rather than part of this seed decision.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request from the DSTU2 ballot asking to rename CareTeam.type to CareTeam.category so the element classifies the kind of care team consistently with other W5 class/category elements.
initial_application: No prior AutoFHIR reconciliation commit existed on the combined branch. Historical source commit c124072d7bc14dd9eea48ac1aaf530bcd31171a6 explicitly mentions #11347 and renamed the CareTeam element/path from CareTeam.type to CareTeam.category in the then-authoritative CareTeam spreadsheet source.
additional_context: CareTeam is active in source/fhir.ini. Current StructureDefinition source defines CareTeam.category with committee note GF#11347, the CareTeam category search parameter uses code category and expression CareTeam.category, FHIR-12247 is a duplicate rename request, and FHIR-11176 is same-block context that expected the name comment to refer to CareTeam.category after this rename. Exact Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current active CareTeam XML source and search-parameter source already use CareTeam.category, and targeted grep found no remaining CareTeam.type element, path, or type search-parameter code in the checked current CareTeam XML source.

related_jiras.note: Separate Jira request to rename CareTeam.type to CareTeam.category; Jira status is Duplicate, so it is not an independent reconciliation target here.
Same CareTeam block vote clarified the relationship between type/category and name, and its resolution noted the usage text should refer to CareTeam.category if FHIR-11347 was approved.
